about: Every record Virginia's 2023 local step moved (data/local/REPORT.md section 33): the working tree after the rebuild against the branch before it (the commit named in 'against'), stamps aside, record by record. New: Virginia's 2023 local contests (1,439) and questions (9), from the Department of Elections' file read before it refused us (pipeline/local_va.py). Typed anew: MEDSL's two 2018 Virginia records of the commissioner of the revenue, a county officer (Constitution of Virginia, art. VII, sec. 4). Reasons changed: 100 records not computed for too few like races, whose class's count of like races moved by one as the 2018 record of two candidates left one class and joined the other. No p moved.
